title: European Roulette
description: Place bets on Red/Black, Even/Odd, or single numbers and spin the wheel.
initScript: window.currentBet = null; window.gameBet = function(type) { window.currentBet = type; document.getElementById('roulette-status').innerText = 'Selected Bet: ' + type.toUpperCase(); };

actionHandlers.spin: if (!window.currentBet) return alert('Select a bet spot first!'); if (state.points < 50) return alert('Not enough points'); state.points -= 50; const win = Math.random() > 0.5; if (win) { state.points += 100; document.getElementById('roulette-status').innerText = 'Winner! You earned 100 pts!'; } else { document.getElementById('roulette-status').innerText = 'No luck this time!'; } updatePointsDisplay();
